page.notes: Greek word at the line end (ἀ-παρτιλογίᾳ) is hard to read; the reading is doubtful. "gvi" at the start of a line is read as qvi with a doubt. The printed long s and ligatures (st, sch) are rendered as s and st; "poteft" is read as "potest". The catchword "qvis" is in the bottom right corner and is kept out of the text.
